Data.description: Interactive Folium HTML map with CartoDB positron basemap centered on Columbia, SC (zoom 14). Each year (2015-2023) is a separate FeatureGroup with LayerControl toggle. CircleMarkers include popups with year, address, date, and lat/lon for each of the 7,959 Street View image points.

Input shapefile containing 7,959 Street View image point locations in Columbia, SC (EPSG:4326). Includes key fields: year (pre-extracted integer, 2015-2023), image_date (YYYY-M format), lat/lng coordinates, descriptio (street address), panoId, and various panorama metadata.

Static thematic map (PNG, 200 DPI, 16x12 inches) showing 7,959 Street View image points in Columbia, SC color-coded by capture year (2015-2023). Uses Tab10 qualitative colormap with a legend placed outside the plot showing year-to-color mapping with point counts per year.
